label: Breathing spine awakening · approved man
instruction: Visualize a hollow luminous column roughly in the center of your back. With every in-breath and out-breath it becomes more awake and energized.

body_sources.registration: exact original 1254 by 1254 canvas, alpha silhouette, seated baseline, and horizontal anchor
body_sources.color: all non-target original RGB pixels are byte-for-byte unchanged
body_sources.outline: only targeted black-looking contour pixels are replaced with coherent original-palette navy

app_registration.method: one shared CSS transform on the animation element; every frame receives the exact same registration
app_registration.target: match the canonical male side-upright solid-pixel height, horizontal center, and seated baseline while retaining the original source pixels

motion: The original body remains perfectly registered and still while the stepped spine illumination reaches the top sooner, flows outward in both directions as one halo pulse, and reverses on exhale.
spine: The locked articulated spine illuminates in the male master's crisp pixel style; at full illumination matched stepped halos expand on both sides, settle, and reverse while the avatar's contour itself remains clean.
